trust.title: Trust the mod “{name}”?
trust.intro: A coding agent asked to enable this mod. It runs inside MoltenTerm with your rights: it can read and change your files and run commands.
trust.introEnd: Trust it only if you know where it comes from.
trust.partWarning: It also carries a Claude Code part that runs inside Claude Code, in every Claude Code session you start in a MoltenTerm terminal, with your rights: it can change what Claude Code shows and does, read files and run commands.
trust.partTitle: Trust the Claude Code part of “{name}”?
trust.partIntro: A coding agent asked to enable this mod, which you trusted before it had a Claude Code part. The part runs inside Claude Code, in every Claude Code session you start in a MoltenTerm terminal, with your rights: it can change what Claude Code shows and does, read files and run commands. Declining keeps the rest of the mod running.
trust.footer: The agent can keep editing it without asking again. Undo with molten mod untrust {id}.

welcome.title: Welcome to MoltenTerm
welcome.tagline: The terminal that takes your shape.
welcome.license: Open source under the Apache License 2.0, built on Wave Terminal.

agent.title: Bring your own agent.
agent.text: MoltenTerm ships no AI. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or any CLI agent runs in it, with your own account.

morph.title: Reshaped by your agent.
morph.text: Ask it with {morph} for a panel, a command or a layout: it writes a mod, MoltenTerm loads it, {undo} takes it back.

sessions.title: Sessions that survive.
sessions.text: Terminals and agents keep running when MoltenTerm quits or updates.

privacy.title: No telemetry, no account.
privacy.text: MoltenTerm sends no usage data and connects only for what you ask.
